description: Use when writing or checking a privacy policy or privacy notice. Lists every item the GDPR requires with its article, for data collected from the person (Art. 13) or obtained from other sources (Art. 14), when the notice must be given, and the exceptions. Tell it which situations apply to drop items you do not need.

automated_decisions.description: Solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects, including profiling (Art. 22)

has_dpo.description: A data protection officer is appointed

source.description: data_subject: collected from the person (forms, accounts, cookies); other_source: from third parties, public sources or data brokers

title: GDPR privacy notice: what it must contain
